content:
marta_fin: FYI — CrescentAI (acct 4127) invoice INV-2026-037 for $62,400 is overdue. AP opened a dispute citing unexpected high token usage and asked for a split payment arrangement.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-037 issued 2026-02-28; due 2026-03-30. PDF: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-037.pdf

sam_collections: Thanks — I reviewed the ledger. Charges are largely for 'batch-embeddings' jobs on 03/14-03/16. AP says their platform shipped a duplicate job. They want a credit for duplicated run + to pay remainder over 2 months.

nilesh_csm: Paging @marta_fin @sam_collections — CrescentAI is a strategic pilot account; product would prefer we avoid hard service cutoff if possible. Can we propose a temporary rate limit instead of suspend?

jess_prod: Agreed with Nilesh. If we throttle embeddings to 2 concurrent jobs it keeps them online and reduces risk of repeated runs. We can push a soft quota immediately.

accounting_ops: Heads up — our policy requires manager approval for split payments > $50k or >60 days. This is $62.4k, so need finance manager sign-off before offering >30 days.

marta_fin: Understood. Requesting approval from @legal-ops for whether contract language allows holding service for nonpayment while negotiating credits. Also need confirmation on acceptable split terms we can offer (max 3 installments?).

legal-ops: The SOW section 4.2 allows suspension for non-payment after 15 days notice; credits require documented evidence of duplicate runs. We can permissibly negotiate a payment plan but recommend deposit >=30% and max 3 installments. Will draft a short amendment.

sam_collections: Proposed plan: 30% up front ($18,720) within 7 days, then 35% ( $21,840 ) 30 days later, final 35% 30 days after that. In exchange we apply a one-time credit of $7,800 for confirmed duplicate runs pending AP providing job IDs and logs.

marta_fin: Can we make the credit contingent on AP providing logs by EOD Thurs (2026-04-08)? If they don't provide, no credit and standard collections timeline resumes.

accounting_ops: We'll need a signed payment amendment. I can draft the amended invoice once terms are final. Also flag: if they miss the first payment, we apply suspension and send to escalation.

nilesh_csm: I'll ask CrescentAI to provide the job IDs and logs and suggest we accept the payment plan to keep UX intact. I can also offer to run a quick usage reconciliation on our side — upload the job IDs to the secure folder: https://drive.redwood/secure/crescentai-4127

marta_fin: Good. @sam_collections please prepare the amendment doc with the payment schedule and credit contingency. @legal-ops please review the amendment draft ASAP. Once we have it, accounting_ops to issue amended invoice. I'll pause escalation for 72 hours from now assuming they submit logs and show intent to pay.

sam_collections: Will draft and post in this thread. Tentative wording for amendment in code block below — replace amounts if legal edits needed:

```
Amendment - INV-2026-037
1) Customer agrees to pay 30% ($18,720) within 7 days of signing
2) Remaining balance paid in two equal installments on day 37 and day 67
3) One-time credit of $7,800 applied if customer provides duplicate job IDs and logs by 2026-04-08
4) Failure to make initial payment permits Redwood to suspend service per SOW 4.2
```

legal-ops: Looks fine. I suggest adding: "Customer must notify Redwood of disputed usage within 10 business days of invoice receipt to qualify for credit consideration."

accounting_ops: OK once legal updates, I'll convert to amended invoice and set payment schedule in Stripe/AR. Can we agree a hard cutoff for suspension date? If amendment signed and first payment made, we keep services. Otherwise suspend on 2026-04-16 EOD.

marta_fin: Agreed. Final plan: offer amendment with 30% upfront, contingent credit for validated duplicates, soft throttle active now, suspension date 2026-04-16 if first payment not received. @nilesh_csm please escalate to customer and confirm they accept terms by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

nilesh_csm: On it. I'll ping their AP and ops leads now and post confirmation here.

sam_collections: Draft posted to thread and uploaded: https://drive.redwood/drafts/crescentai-amendment.docx

marta_fin: Thanks team. Closing hold for 72h while we await logs + payment intent. If no movement by 2026-04-09 17:00 PT, proceed with suspension and escalation.

billing-bot: Note logged: collections plan initiated for customer 4127, case#COL-2026-059.

nilesh_csm: AP just replied, asked for our usage export and accepts the 30% deposit as a starting point. They will provide job IDs by tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:

marta_fin: Perfect. Sam/accounting/legal — please finalize amendment ASAP. I'll move this to watchlist.
